name: Fatura: kagit fatura (kismi tutar), tutar siniri, geri alma
description: TEST hastasinin faturasiz odemesi icin elle yazilmis fatura kaydi.

planSteps.description: Log in with the TEST account credentials configured for this project
Open patient 'TEST Senaryo HASTA', go to the 'Fatura' tab and click the 'Kagit Fatura Kesildi' sub tab
Verify the list of un-invoiced payments is shown with checkboxes and a selected payment total
Enter invoice number 'TEST-0001', keep today's date, and set the invoice amount to half of the selected payment total
Verify a note appears saying this is a partial invoice and the VAT is calculated only on the invoiced amount
Verify invoice 'TEST-0001' appears in the 'Kesilen Faturalar' table with the half amount
Try to record another invoice with an amount larger than the payment total
Verify the save button is disabled or an error says the invoice amount cannot exceed the selected payments
Remove the 'TEST-0001' invoice record from the table and confirm
Verify the invoice disappears and the payment is listed again as un-invoiced
